Yeah hi, I'm calling about my roof — it got damaged in a storm and I want to know if my insurance covers it.

I understand, that sounds stressful. I can help you register that damage so an adjuster can look into it. Before we go further, I need to verify you're the policyholder. Can you give me your date of birth and the last four digits of your policy number?
Sure, date of birth is July 21st, 1958, and the last four digits are 2290.

Uh, it was last Thursday, the 10th.
Got it, the tenth. And what month was that?
This month, July.
Perfect, so July the tenth. Now, what exactly was damaged on your roof?

I hear you. An adjuster will decide what's covered and how much will be paid once they review your claim. Right now I just need to get the details down so they can look at it.
